artworks.title: View on the Orwell
artworks.description: The image shows a ship angled on a shoreline near a body of water. The horizon line is low, separating the dark water from the lighter sky. A windmill and a small boat with rowers are visible on the right. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a misty atmosphere. The color palette is muted sepia. Figures are gathered near the ships, with details blending into the softness of the image. The background has a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Summer Morning
artworks.description: This is an image of a countryside landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is in the middle of the image, showing fields and trees. In the distance, there is a tower, potentially a church. The brushstrokes are fine and smooth, creating a lifelike texture. The sky has soft clouds and sunlight rays. The color palette includes black, white, and gray tones. In the foreground, there are farm tools, a figure near cows, and birds flying.

artworks.title: Summer Afternoon, after a Shower
artworks.description: This image depicts a black and white landscape with an aerial view of a pastoral scene. The horizon is positioned two-thirds up from the bottom, meeting swirling clouds in the sky. The sky occupies a significant portion of the image with darker clouds on the left and lighter clouds on the right. A windmill is visible on a hill to the right, and the field in the foreground has cows, a figure, and a dog. Loose brushstrokes create movement and texture in the land and sky. The image uses varying shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: Glebe Farm (b)
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with natural and architectural elements. The horizon is low with trees, buildings, and a church with a tall tower and cross. A path winds through lush foliage and trees on the left. A river cuts through the scene, with a cow in the water. The brushwork shows intricate details in foliage and clouds, depicting a play of light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using deep blacks, soft grays, and subtle whites for contrast. Clouds scatter across a turbulent sky, enhancing the atmospheric effect.

artworks.title: Salisbury Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows a river running through the center of the scene, with trees and a church with a tall spire on the horizon underneath dramatic clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures in the foliage and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and charcoal. A figure is seen fishing by the riverbank, with a fence leading towards the church spire in the distance.

artworks.title: Hadleigh Castle (Small Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient, crumbling walls or towers in the foreground. A figure and a dog are nearby. The land stretches towards a distant horizon under a dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds. Light breaks through, casting shadows and creating contrast with streaks across the landscape. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of shades of gray, black, and white.

artworks.title: The Lock
artworks.description: The image displays a view from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is lower in the composition, with a wide sky. In the distance, there is a small structure. The sky has dramatic cloud formations. In the foreground, there is a body of water with wooden structures and people nearby. A large, lush tree dominates the right side. The color palette is shades of grey, giving a classic feel.

artworks.title: The Cornfield
artworks.description: The image features a rural scene captured from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, showing a distant field and vast, cloud-filled sky. Thick brushstrokes show texture in the foliage of large trees framing a meandering path. Near the viewer, a figure rests by a water source surrounded by rural objects and underbrush. A flock of sheep and a dog move down the pathway, leading to open countryside in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic with soft grays and browns, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Steele's Cottages
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with buildings and trees on either side. In the distance, a cityscape can be seen with a domed structure and spires. The street leads towards this cityscape. The drawing uses a monochrome palette with various shades of gray and black. Soft, blended strokes are used throughout, especially in the sky with dramatic clouds.

artworks.title: Mill near Colchester
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a low horizon line. Distant trees and structures are visible. Expressive brushstrokes depict clouds and water with movement. The color palette is primarily dark brown and black on a light beige background. Closest to the viewer are vegetation and a possible structure like a mill or cottage. The sky is expansive with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: The Nativity with Saints Francis and Agnes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash with white heightening over black chalk; traces of incising
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing featuring five figures: three adults, a young child, and an infant. They are arranged in a composition around the infant, who lies centrally on a cloth. The infant is depicted nude and lying down with one hand slightly raised. An elderly man kneels close to the infant, while another elderly figure stands behind him with a staff. To the right, a woman is kneeling in a position of contemplation, and another woman is stooping over. The figures are wearing robes with soft, flowing lines, set against a plain background.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene featuring architectural edifices and richly-dressed figures. The artwork depicts an intricate cityscape with tall, ornate buildings and a large, castle-like structure on the left. The foreground is filled with a procession of elaborately dressed figures and horses moving towards a seated figure holding a child. The figures are adorned in regal attire, some wearing crowns, and they carry ornate objects. In the background, there is a grouping of other figures, some engaged in different activities. The trees and hills suggest a rural setting beyond the town. The drawing captures the richness of the clothing and the architecture with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Four Dancing Muses
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: This print shows four women depicted in full-length, standing and appearing to be engaged in a circular dance. They are positioned such that two are facing right, one towards us, and one facing left. The women have pale skin, long, straight noses, and arched eyebrows, with long, wavy hair styled in a variety of ways, including loose curls and braided updos. Their attire consists of flowing, intricately detailed robes that drape around their bodies, with ribbons and sashes floating in the air beside them. The women are barefoot, and their raised arms and feet suggest a dance. The background is a crosshatched pattern surrounded by a blank border.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.1 x 43.4 cm (11 1/16 x 17 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and hatching on cream-white paper, a woman clutching an infant runs toward us as muscular men attack other women holding babies to each side in front of a town in this horizonal engraving. At the far left, a woman hunches over a motionless child, her hand on the baby’s chest. A nude man nearby unsheathes a sword as he grabs the leg of a child held by a woman, who attempts to turn protectively away. A kneeling woman to the right braces her child behind her back and reaches up to defend herself against a man swinging a sword back to strike. Another man pulls a woman’s hair in the background and a third stabs a woman in the chest as she clutches her child to her other shoulder. Two more baby boys lie already dead underfoot. The people are closely packed and overlapping, and many reach or gesture upward or outward. The scene takes place on a paved or stone town square in front of an arching bridge. Stone structures rise beyond the bridge, and clouds skim across the otherwise blank sky. On the stone wall to the left, there is a rectangular plaque inscribed with “RAPH VRBI INVE” and the initials MA intertwined.

artworks.title: Alexander and Thaïs Setting Fire to Persepolis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening on paper washed orange-brown
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in a dynamic pose. Both individuals are standing, facing each other. One figure on the left has an outstretched arm. They are wearing a helmet with a plume and scant armor, while the figure on the right is adorned in flowing garments. The scene appears to be set indoors, with subtle architectural lines in the background and an indistinct depiction of people or statues in the distance. The drawing emphasizes the contours and form of the clothing and bodies.

artworks.title: Studies of a Holy Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and pink wash, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper washed sanguine
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, including seated adults with infants and flying cherubs. The composition includes central seated adults with surrounding infants, some being held and others flying. The outlines have detailed expressions and drapery folds with dynamic strokes. The background features sketches of small cherub-like figures. The color palette is muted with earthy tones and highlights.

artworks.title: Title Page: Pedestal and a Pair of Dogs
artworks.description: This is an image of a dedication plaque set in a natural scene. The plaque is adorned with foliated designs including leaves and possibly classical figures or mythical creatures. There is text on the plaque dedicating it to an individual with several titles. A boar is depicted on the left near a tree trunk, and two dogs stand to the right of the plaque. The scene is surrounded by detailed sketches of shrubbery and natural elements. The drawing showcases fine linear techniques to create contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Four Dogs, One Sleeping beside a Capital
artworks.description: The image depicts a rough-textured structure resembling an archway or tunnel. The scene shows a tunnel vision effect pointing towards the center where two dogs are located. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the interior of a ruin or cave-like space. Brushstrokes are meticulous, with cross-hatching creating texture and depth in the arch and the fur of the animals. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. A fallen column and stones are on the ground. In the background, more stonework and a wooden fence are visible, adding to the sense of an ancient or forgotten place.

artworks.title: Two Greyhounds, Leashed and Facing Opposite Directions
artworks.description: Two animals are depicted in a detailed drawing in a rocky natural setting. The animals are engaged in a dynamic interaction, with one recoiling upwards while the other bites its neck. The background features textured shrubbery and small trees, adding depth to the scene. The monochrome palette of the drawing adds a classic and timeless feel, emphasizing form and composition over color.

artworks.title: Two Beagles, One Sleeping
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs in a natural setting. The illustration depicts two dogs, one standing alertly while the other is lying down. The drawing utilizes intricate line work to convey texture in the dogs' fur and the surrounding elements, such as the foliage, tree branches, and ground. In the background, there is a suggestion of dense plants or grasses and a leafless tree. The artist's use of cross-hatching and fine lines creates a sense of realism and detail, particularly in rendering the animals and their environment.

artworks.title: Two Greyhounds, Leashed and Facing Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three dogs. Two dogs are standing and pulling on a leash, while a third dog is lying down. The background shows trees, a distant structure, and a lightly textured sky. The drawing is detailed, with fine lines depicting the dogs' fur and muscles, and the rough ground they are on. The scene appears to capture a pause in the dogs' activity.

artworks.title: Two Dogs Copulating
artworks.description: The image features two dogs on a rocky slope. The horizon is low in the composition, with foliage and trees in the distance. The artwork has sketch-like brushstrokes, showcasing intricate details of the dogs and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. A stone structure, a statue, tall trees, and clouds are also visible.

artworks.title: Two Mastiffs beside a Fountain
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs resting near a fountain in a landscape. The drawing depicts two large dogs with intricate fur texture details. They are positioned by a fountain with elaborate decorations, including a water-spouting figure. The background shows a natural setting with lush foliage, a tree, and distant hills. In the background, there are towers and architectural structures hinting at a nearby settlement or town. Fine lines and shading are used to add depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Landscape with Greyhound and Rifle
artworks.description: This drawing shows a dog in a landscape. The dog is standing on rocky terrain with a backdrop of rugged rocks and trees. There are detailed renderings of foliage and branches in the foreground. The artist used cross-hatching for shading and detail, creating depth and naturalism. The sky above is lightly etched, suggesting openness. The dog appears attentive. This drawing is in the style of Stefano della Bella.
